note: The ratchet of `pnpm check:coverage` (DEC-0141). `max` is the worst tally this repository is allowed to have. A run worse than a number here fails; a run better than one fails too, asking for the number to be lowered in the same commit, so that a gain is recorded instead of left as budget to spend again. Raising a number is a governance change: it needs a decision record, and the record says which criteria were let go and why.
measured_on: T-19, the test-alignment sweep (DEC-0144), with its QA round. Measured against `next-2026` at 0c56cfc by comparing the two reports criterion by criterion: MISSING 145 -> 136 and NAMED ONLY 32 -> 30. Eleven criteria closed — eight out of MISSING (TS-WEB-0002-A9 with e2e/reduced-motion.spec.ts; TS-WEB-0003-A7 as METERED on the CI job that runs the CLS observer, its level being `tool`; TS-WEB-0017-A1/A2/A7/A17/A19 and TS-WEB-0017-A5 because check-stack.ts and check-brand.ts prefixed their failure messages with a bare `A2`/`A19` and the report line pasted `TS-017-` in front of it, which is no identifier this repository defines, so the meters were METERED for nothing) and three out of NAMED ONLY (TS-WEB-0017-A6, TS-WEB-0017-A12 by walking every route at two widths instead of `/` alone, TS-WEB-0018-A12 with an integration test that runs the whole chain from a stubbed-empty stats upstream through the production `CountersIsland` to the rendered markup). One title lost an identifier rather than gaining one: src/lib/analytics/call-sites.test.ts claimed TS-WEB-0012-A2, an `e2e` criterion about cookies and hosts that a source scan cannot observe; A2 stays VERIFIED through e2e/privacy.spec.ts, which is its real instrument, so the removal costs no coverage and removes a false one. **One number moved the wrong way: NAMED ONLY 29 -> 30, and the criterion let go is TS-WEB-0013-A4** (DEC-0144 §10, QA round 1). A4 gained the static test this sweep was asked for — scripts/check-csp-allowlist.test.ts parses the TS-WEB-0013 D2 table out of the specification and compares it with the CSP allowlist — and the measurement says the two sides differ by three hosts the policy carries and D2 has no row for. A4 reads *"equals the D2 host set exactly"*, so a test title naming it would have reported closed coverage for a sentence the repository does not fulfil: the same false green DEC-0142 §9 took back for TS-WEB-0018-A7, and the precedent this note was written to keep. The id therefore stands in the file's docblock and in no test title, A4 is NAMED ONLY, which is what it is, and the test fails on any change to either side. The day the spec owner writes the three D2 rows or has the three hosts taken out of the policy, the declared divergences go empty, the id moves into the title and this number goes back to 29. TS-WEB-0006-A18 is the same shape and cost no number: it was already VERIFIED at 0c56cfc through the tier tests that predate this task (e2e/pages/dein-kalender.spec.ts, src/components/price-section/price-tier-row.test.tsx), which assert the tier half that holds; the site-wide walk added in e2e/cta-ladder.spec.ts names the id on the ten routes where A18's "exactly one" is what the page does and does not name it on the two whose module is declared CTA-free (state/open.md rows 279 and 280).
